The proposed course matches use the receiving university’s published evidence. Individual admission, prior-learning evaluation and any required future-course approval remain the university’s decisions. This preview does not award credits or promise a completion date or complete degree price.

Beyond the course list

  • Overall and major GPA At least 2.0 overall and major GPA; no grade below C may count toward the major.
  • Writing-intensive coursework Complete at least three designated writing-intensive courses: ENG-105 or its equivalent and two in the major, at least one upper division. The selected native baseline includes ENG-105, ENG-106, BUS-340 and BUS-485.
  • Campus mathematics and English placement Meet the campus placement/approved-prerequisite conditions before registering in MAT-144 and ENG-105. Any needed developmental preparation is separate from the 120 degree-credit ledger.

GCU’s transfer rules

  • Up to 90 semester credits from other sources can count toward the 120-credit degree.
  • At least 30 semester credits must be completed at GCU.
  • At least 36 semester credits must be upper-level.
  • GCU caps alternative credit at 30 semester credits.

Source: GCU Fall 2026 University Policy Handbook — bachelor graduation, residency, upper division and writing · GCU Fall 2026 University Policy Handbook — baccalaureate transfer policies · GCU Fall 2026 University Policy Handbook — alternative credit source treatment

Questions

Does Sophia English Composition II transfer to Grand Canyon University?

Yes, for this degree. GCU’s published transfer guidance lists Sophia English Composition II for ENG-106 English Composition II (3 semester credits) in the Bachelor of Science in Business Administration.

Does ASU Universal Learner The Living World transfer to Grand Canyon University?

Yes, for this degree. GCU’s published transfer guidance lists ASU Universal Learner The Living World for PHI-105 21st Century Skills: Critical Thinking and Problem Solving (4 semester credits) in the Bachelor of Science in Business Administration.

Does ASU Universal Learner Introduction to Environmental Science transfer to Grand Canyon University?

Yes, for this degree. GCU’s published transfer guidance lists ASU Universal Learner Introduction to Environmental Science for BIO-220 Environmental Science (4 semester credits) in the Bachelor of Science in Business Administration.

How many credits can I transfer into Grand Canyon University’s Bachelor of Science in Business Administration?

GCU’s published limit for this 120-credit degree is 90 semester credits from other sources. At least 30 semester credits must be completed at GCU. This plan proposes 26 semester credits through outside courses.

Which courses must I take at Grand Canyon University?

In this plan, 94 semester credits are taken at GCU, including UNV-103 University Success, CWV-101 Christian Worldview, LDR-461 Professional Applications in Service Learning I, LDR-462 Professional Applications in Service Learning II and LDR-463 Professional Applications in Service Learning III. GCU requires at least 30 semester credits at GCU.

Has Grand Canyon University confirmed this plan?

This plan uses GCU’s published degree requirements and transfer guidance. Admission and your own transcript evaluation are still GCU’s decisions.
